editorial:
Imagine being in your twenties and feeling like your love life is a total wreck. That is exactly where you find our three main characters. To fix their luck, these buddies decide to head to Aspen for a wild vacation. Their goal is simple: hunt for cougars. You know, those attractive older women who are looking for younger guys to spice things up. The whole vibe is very lighthearted and silly, making it the kind of movie you put on when you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some awkward dating situations.

While the plot is pretty basic, the chemistry between the guys keeps things moving along. Some of the jokes land better than others, but the pacing is quick enough that you won't get bored. If you enjoy raunchy comedies about guys acting like idiots, you will probably have a blast with this one. It is a solid choice for a lazy weekend with friends.
endingExplained: After all the chaos and dating mishaps in Aspen, the guys realize that chasing older women was more about their own egos than actual love. They eventually find a balance between their wild instincts and real emotions. The movie wraps up with the friends learning a lesson about maturity and relationships. They leave the trip with a better understanding of themselves and a few funny stories to tell back home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raunchy comedies and stories about friendship.
